text: Being here, I am struck by the fusion of glass, reflection, digital projections, and bright utility objects; a space meticulously arranged, evoking thoughts about transparency—both physical and intellectual. Entering the second room, immersed in bold colors and words about innovation, research, and rapid evolution, I feel a strange blend of curiosity and self-awareness. The museum-quality displays magnify the researcher's urge to observe and be observed, questioning where I—an observing subject—fit among these orchestrated knowledges. It feels simultaneously inspiring and slightly unsettling, carrying the weight of future expectations.
